Subject: Vendr credential matrix sync + delta evidence request

Hi Arielle / Acme security team,

Thanks again for partnering on the Vendr profile refresh. We did a quick sweep of your existing profile and have a few items to align so the portal shows the right canonical proofs and minimal artifacts for audits. To keep this lightweight, can you help with the following?

1) SIG -> CAIQ mapping: a short table (CSV) identifying which SIG question maps to the CAIQ control you consider authoritative and any recent deltas since your last submission.
2) Delta evidence bundle: any documents changed in the last 12 months (signed manifests preferred) and a short note on why they changed.
3) KMS rotation proof: brief summary (one page) showing rotation cadence and signing material.
4) S3 evidence staging: preferred upload window and whether you require pre-signed links or a temporary ingest account.
5) Minimal proof for third-party attestation: if you have an executive summary PDF or SOC 2 snapshot we can link, please include.

I've attached a manifest template (redwood_vendr_evidence_manifest_template.csv) and our mutual action plan (mutual_action_plan_revised.pdf) to speed up mapping. If it's easier, we can do a 30-minute handoff call to walk through the manifest and the S3 staging process.

Proposed times: Wed Jun 20 10:00-10:30 PT or Thu Jun 21 09:00-09:30 PT. Let me know which works and whether you need an SSO/delegated upload approach.

Thanks,

Evelyn Hart
Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_vendr_evidence_manifest_template.csv (CSV), mutual_action_plan_revised.pdf (PDF)

For S3, we prefer to use pre-signed upload links for bulk evidence; if Redwood needs an upload account, we can provision one scoped to a short time window.

Wed Jun 20 10:00 PT works for us. I'll accept a calendar invite.

Best,
Arielle Chen
